Gen Z protests lead to minister's resignation amid exam controversies

Weeks of Gen Z-led protests, dubbed the 'Cockroach' movement, have led to the resignation of a key minister. The protests, which utilized new and classic poetry and slogans like 'Kuchupuchu, resign kar do', focused on issues including alleged paper leaks and accountability in national examinations. The government has responded by forming a high-powered task force for exam reforms, led by Nandan Nilekani, following the NEET controversy.
